notes: Fixes the long freeze when leaving a stream that is playing on the backup player -- shutting it down was blocking the interface, and now happens in the background. Startup wait shortened too. Note: for very large 4K files the backup player has to decode in software, which uses all of the box's CPU and causes the blocky picture and sluggish menus. A 1080p version of the same title should play smoothly on the main player.
